ownership: No baked ownership. Assignment is derived from the distribution code at read time, identically on every machine.
notes: Presentation layer is FROZEN. A nightly data refresh replaces only the __PAYLOAD__ marker. Any change to the template or builder requires a new design_v and fresh hashes in this file.

distribution.code_format: L~s~m~mt~lj~eq~tr~rv~cx~z~n~r (positional, '~' separated, trailing blanks trimmed; zips '.' separated)
distribution.deal: pool sorted by score desc then id; agent i takes indices where i % rosterSize; block = slice((round-1)*n, round*n)
